recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original non-substantive wording correction across current active narrative pages without changing conformance semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-8067 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU1 MedicationPrescription. It asked to replace 'An order for both supply of the medication and the instructions for administration of the medicine to a patient.' with the same sentence using 'medication' instead of 'medicine'.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically in svn/git commit ef67da50345c3f324ff27053b95b42e8a463184b, which changed source/medicationprescription/medicationprescription-spreadsheet.xml. In the current source, MedicationPrescription has become MedicationRequest, and structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml already contains the corrected 'medication' wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources in the Pharmacy work group and notes the MedicationPrescription to MedicationRequest rename. Jira search found the seed and unrelated/background pharmacy issues but no later final decision reversing this terminology correction. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant or conflicting community discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: Changed the MedicationRequest row in source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-introduction.xml, source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-introduction.xml, source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-introduction.xml, and source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml so each says 'administration of the medication to a patient'.
source_changes: source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-introduction.xml: changed the MedicationRequest row from 'administration of the medicine' to 'administration of the medication'.
source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-introduction.xml: changed the MedicationRequest row from 'administration of the medicine' to 'administration of the medication'.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-introduction.xml: changed the MedicationRequest row from 'administration of the medicine' to 'administration of the medication'.
source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: changed the MedicationRequest row from 'administration of the medicine' to 'administration of the medication'.
